message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate the cost of a business class ticket for the first airport on the available list to the last airport on the same list, on the last day of October 2026. They also want the estimated total payable amount.

We have a function get_list_all_airports. That returns a list of airports. We need to find the first and last airport codes. Then we call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2026-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to provide the estimated total payable amount. But what about other costs? Possibly insurance? The user didn't mention insurance. So just the flight cost. But maybe they want to include taxes? The function get_flight_cost presumably includes all costs. So we can just give that.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports. Then parse the result. Then call get_flight_cost. Then respond with the cost.
